history.summary: A freehold 1,335 sqft 4BR at Scenic Heights (D12, Balestier/Toa Payoh fringe) for $2.38M / $1,783 psf. Freehold and a strong-looking 6.5%/yr rate are attractive, but the rate sits on only 9 txns and the listing is ~7% above the project median, with no MRT listed.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold tenure and a fair $2.38M quantum are positives, and the high arena Elo (1502) reflects favourable cost/value scoring. But the headline 6.5%/yr appreciation is built on just 9 URA transactions — too thin to rely on. The listing PSF ($1,783) is ~7.5% above the project's $1,659 median, i.e. priced toward the top of the project's range. No MRT within easy walk per dossier, and a built-2005 4BR in a smaller D12 development is a niche family resale. Mixed picture nets to Neutral.
red_flags: No MRT proximity listed; older (2005) 4BR, niche resale
